description: Extend performance test suite: query count assertions, cache behaviour tests, concurrency tests for inventory deduction and stock transfer, and pagination enforcement. Move existing top-level tests to the canonical test_performance directory. Write load testing infrastructure.
steps: 1. Create backend/tests/test_performance/ directory with __init__.py. Copy (do not delete) existing backend/tests/test_queries.py content into backend/tests/test_performance/test_query_counts.py. Copy existing backend/tests/test_cache.py into backend/tests/test_performance/test_cache.py. Copy existing backend/tests/test_concurrency.py into backend/tests/test_performance/test_concurrency.py. Copy existing backend/tests/test_pagination.py into backend/tests/test_performance/test_pagination.py. Keep originals in place (do not remove them).

2. In backend/tests/test_performance/test_query_counts.py, add a new test class MenuCatalogQueryTest with a test that creates 10 MenuItem rows with prices and availability, calls the menu catalog endpoint, and uses self.assertNumQueries(upper_bound) to assert the total query count is <= 5 (not 10+). This catches N+1 regression on the MenuItem list.

3. In backend/tests/test_performance/test_query_counts.py, add a DashboardKPIQueryTest that calls the dashboard KPI endpoint twice and asserts the second call uses 0 or 1 queries (the cache hit path). Use unittest.mock.patch to mock CacheService.get to return a pre-set value on the second call if Redis is not available in test.

4. In backend/tests/test_performance/test_cache.py, add a test class CacheInvalidationIntegrationTest (TransactionTestCase) that: creates a MenuItem, calls invalidate_menu_catalog(branch_id), then verifies CacheService.get(menu_catalog_key(branch_id, '')) returns None after the commit. This confirms the on_commit hook fires.

5. In backend/tests/test_performance/test_concurrency.py, add a ConcurrentInventoryDeductionTest (TransactionTestCase): two threads each call the inventory deduction service for the same StockBalance item with quantity 60 when only 100 units are available. Assert that only one succeeds or combined deductions do not exceed available stock (quantity >= 0 after both threads complete).

6. In backend/tests/test_performance/test_concurrency.py, add a ConcurrentStockTransferTest (TransactionTestCase): two threads concurrently initiate a stock transfer from the same source location for the same item. Assert that the total transferred quantity does not exceed available stock.

7. In backend/tests/test_performance/test_pagination.py, add a test that verifies the orders list endpoint returns at most 100 items when ?page_size=500 is passed (enforced by SafePageNumberPagination.max_page_size=100).

8. Create performance/locustfile.py with a RestaurantFlowUser class (HttpUser, wait_time between_tasks(1,3)). Include tasks: login (POST /api/auth/token/), menu_catalog (GET /api/menu/?branch_id=...), create_order (POST /api/orders/), confirm_order (POST /api/orders/{id}/confirm/), create_bill (POST /api/bills/), finalize_bill (POST /api/bills/{id}/finalize/), create_payment (POST /api/payments/), inventory_dashboard (GET /api/inventory/stock-balances/?branch=...), reporting_query (GET /api/reports/sales/?date_from=...&date_to=...). Use @task(weight) decorators; login weight=1, menu_catalog weight=10, create_order weight=5.
9. Create performance/scenarios/ with individual files: login.py, menu_catalog.py, order_flow.py (create+confirm+bill+payment), inventory_check.py, reporting.py. Each file defines a TaskSet class.

10. Create performance/test_data/seed.py: a script that uses Django management commands to create 1 company, 1 restaurant, 2 branches, 10 menu items with prices, 2 counters, and 1 test user, outputting their IDs to performance/test_data/fixtures.json for Locust to read.

11. Create performance/README.md documenting: how to start locust (locust -f performance/locustfile.py --host http://localhost:8000), how to seed data (python performance/test_data/seed.py), scenario descriptions, target metrics (menu catalog <100ms p95, order creation <300ms p95).
12. Create docs/load_testing.md with the same content as performance/README.md plus interpretation guidance.
acceptance_criteria: python manage.py test --settings=config.test_settings tests.test_performance passes all tests
ConcurrentInventoryDeductionTest passes: inventory quantity never goes negative
ConcurrentStockTransferTest passes: transfer quantity never exceeds available stock
performance/locustfile.py exists and is importable (python -c 'import locust; exec(open("performance/locustfile.py").read())' or equivalent syntax check)
